summary: Carry the current canonical Karmic runtime into beta: Kimi-K3 EXL3 serving, MLA memory and DCP transport options, activation reuse and decode scheduling options
compatibility: No user action required. The new MLA workspace, DCP transport, projection sharding, prefetch and draft-cache controls are opt-in and default off.
details: Kimi-K3 MLA gets configurable context workspaces, projection scratch reuse, optional PCIe query and LSE transport and context-gather overlap (#924).

Kimi-K3 bounds vision intermediates, gathers variable-length image embeddings without padding, reuses consumed activations and adds optional projection sharding, L2 prefetch and KDA projection overlap (#925).
The B12X attention backend selects B12X MLA for dense MLA layers; sparse MLA layers keep their existing backend.
